project.title: dbhaven: Scheduled Encrypted Database Backup & Disaster Recovery Engine for IBM Db2
project.short_description: Production-grade, scheduled, AES-256-GCM encrypted offsite backup and automated disaster recovery pipeline for IBM Db2 databases with S3/local storage and GFS retention.

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition 12.1.2+ (Docker) / Db2 on Cloud / Db2 LUW Enterprise
ibm_db2.connector: ibm_db / Native Db2 CLI Engine & ibm_db_sa
features_used: Online Database Hot Backups (db2 backup database online)
Streaming compressed image pipeline to S3 and local storage
Chunked authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption with SHA-256 integrity tags
Grandfather-Father-Son (GFS) lifecycle pruning and retention policies
Zero-downtime point-in-time recovery and automated verification
